blurb: Big White Ski Resort offers mountain biking rentals and repairs, guided e-bike tours for various skill levels, and comprehensive mountain safety guidelines for summer and winter activities. Rentals include protective gear and an equipment damage protection plan. E-bike tours are guided, small group experiences tailored to rider ability, with included e-bike and helmet.
extraNote: Equipment Damage Protection Plan is non-refundable and covers accidental damage only, excludes theft, loss, negligent damage, and damage during races · Half day rentals are walk-in only, cannot be booked in advance · Credit card security swipe required for all rentals; debit and prepaid cards not accepted for security swipe · Village Centre for e-bike tours · Summer season July 1 through September 7
